name: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
site: Addenbrooke's Hospital. The modelled footprint is the ED front door (resus, majors trolleys, majors ambulant, minors, paeds) with SDEC as a co-located area. CUH's own extracts count the paediatric ED as an area within the department.
as_of: CUH CHEQS extracts Feb-Aug 2026 (batch 1, received 12 Aug 2026 from Joshua at CUH); NHS England publications June 2026 (A&E/ECDS) and Q4 2025-26 (beds)
status: REAL BUILD - headline volumes and validation targets are transcribed from NHS England publications (files under data/), and the distribution blocks (hourly shape, area/acuity mix, ambulance share, admission rates) are computed from CUH's own CHEQS extracts committed under data/cuh/. Each block cites its exact file. Where an internal figure and a published figure measure the same thing differently, the note says so - see docs/CUH_DATA_LOG.md for the reconciliation.

attendances_per_day.note: The volume anchor stays the PUBLISHED Type 1 figure. CUH's internal per-area counts give 446.2/day for the same front-door footprint over Feb-Jul 2026 (80,771 attendances / 181 days, data/cuh/Performance *.xlsx) - the ~11% gap is a counting-basis difference (internal area counts include planned returns and did-not-waits that the published Type 1 series treats differently), logged in docs/CUH_DATA_LOG.md.
attendances_per_day.source: NHS England monthly A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions, June 2026 provider CSV (data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv), row RGT: 'A&E attendances Type 1' = 12,015 / 30. https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/ae-waiting-times-and-activity/

four_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET (not a model input). Corroborated by ECDS provisional 4 Hour Performance: 53.58% T1&2. CUH internal cross-check: front-door areas (excl SDEC) Feb-Jul 2026 show 59.5% within 4 hours on the CHEQS counting basis (data/cuh/Performance *.xlsx, breaches/attendances) - internal counts include did-not-waits, so the published series remains the target.
four_hour_pct.source: data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv row RGT: 1 - (5,656 over-4hrs Type 1 / 12,015 Type 1 attendances). ECDS corroboration: data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, '4 Hour Performance', row RGT.

twelve_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET. DTA-based (matches the model's 12-hour bed-wait metric): 445 patients waited 12+ hrs from decision-to-admit, / 12,015 Type 1 attendances. The ECDS 12-hours-FROM-ARRIVAL measure is higher: 1,390 of 12,280 T1&2 = 11.32% (all types 7.82%).
twelve_hour_pct.source: data/June-2026-CSV-Wfg38l.csv row RGT ('Patients who have waited 12+ hrs from DTA to admission'); data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, '12 Hour Performance', row RGT.

hourly_shares.granularity: provided (CUH extract, ED front door, May-Aug 2026)
hourly_shares.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Arrivals and departures by hour May to Aug 26.xlsx (46,132 arrivals by hour of day, May-Aug 2026; excludes direct-to-SDEC referrals). Shares are each hour's arrivals / 46,132.

acuity_mix_pct.note: Mapping, stated plainly: the model's acuity bands are proxied by CUH's own treatment areas over the ADULT front door (resus = Acuity 1, majors trolleys = 2, majors ambulant = 3, minors = 4). CUH's extract is by area, not triage category, so minors carries bands 4 and 5 together (Acuity 5 set to zero rather than invented). Paediatric arrivals are routed separately by paediatric_share; SDEC is modelled as the streamed destination, not front-door demand.
acuity_mix_pct.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Performance Resus.xlsx, Performance Majors Trolleys.xlsx, Performance Majors Ambulant.xlsx, Performance Minors.xlsx - Total Att summed Feb-Jul 2026 (1,754 / 13,211 / 29,544 / 25,481 of 69,990 adult front-door attendances).

ambulance_share.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Arrivals Ambulance May to Aug 2026.xlsx (8,830 ambulance arrivals) / data/cuh/Arrivals and departures by hour May to Aug 26.xlsx (46,132 total front-door arrivals). Walk-ins (data/cuh/arrivals ambulant May to Aug 2026.xlsx) are 34,088; the 3,214 residual is other modes (recorded ~1/hour in data/cuh/Arrivals Other.xlsx).

admission_rate_by_acuity.note: Same area-proxy bands as acuity_mix_pct: resus 1,304/1,754 admitted, trolleys 7,404/13,211, majors ambulant 1,251/29,544, minors 14/25,481. Acuity 5 is null because no CUH area maps to it (its share is zero). Paeds admit 1,444/10,781 = 13.4%; SDEC 4,179/26,022 = 16.1% (routed by area, not these bands).
admission_rate_by_acuity.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Performance *.xlsx, Total Adm / Total Att summed Feb-Jul 2026.

paediatric_share.note: CUH's own paediatric ED area: 10,781 of 80,771 front-door attendances. CONFIRMED by CUH 13 Aug 2026: CHEQS includes paediatrics as its own area, not as a separate return - so the area-based routing below is the right reading and the CHEQS and published Type 1 footprints agree. The PUBLISHED age-based figure is higher (2,420 of 12,280 T1&2 = 19.71%, June 2026 ECDS) because children treated outside the paeds area still count by age; the model routes by AREA, so the extract figure drives routing and the published figure stays here as the age-based cross-check.
paediatric_share.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Performance Paeds.xlsx, Total Att summed Feb-Jul 2026 / all five front-door areas. Published cross-check: data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, 'Paediatric Performance', row RGT.

mental_health_share.note: REAL: 315 MH attendances / 12,280 T1&2. The published figure stays the input; CHEQS batch 2 now corroborates it from CUH's own records at 2.28% (1,067 MH attendances over 104 days = 10.3/day, against the 450.1/day front door) - see cuh_extracts.mental_health below for the disposal split.
mental_health_share.source: data/ECDS_Performance_Provisional_Jun_26_2026-07-03_091942_VZF6MT.xlsx, 'Mental Health', row RGT. Internal corroboration: data/cuh/MH Disposals.xlsx.

investigation_rates.granularity: provided (CUH extract, department total, no acuity breakdown)
investigation_rates.note: REAL, and it replaces a pure assumption: the model's imaging_decision routing (CT/X-ray probability by acuity) was invented. These are WORKLOAD rates - investigations per attendance, so a patient imaged twice counts twice. That is the right basis for a capacity model (it reproduces the demand on the CT scanner and X-ray room), but it is an upper bound on the PROPORTION of patients imaged, so do not read it as '39% of patients get an X-ray'. apply_patch scales the per-acuity probabilities by a single factor to hit this acuity-weighted average, keeping the assumed clinical gradient across acuity (sicker patients imaged more) because the extract has no acuity breakdown. DENOMINATOR CAVEAT: computed against the 5-area front door (450.1/day, May-Jul 2026), which is the population the model's imaging_decision serves. If CUH's investigations extract also counts SDEC activity, the correct rates are the all-areas figures ct 0.139 / xray 0.297 - CUH to confirm which footprint the extract covers.
investigation_rates.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Investigation types.xlsx - 'Computerized axial tomography (procedure) (77477000)' 8,065 and 'Plain radiography (procedure) (168537006)' 17,284 over the 14 complete weeks 10 May-9 Aug 2026 (the part-weeks ending 03/05/26 and 16/08/26 are excluded). Denominator 3,151 attendances/week = 41,413 front-door attendances May-Jul 2026 / 92 days x 7 (data/cuh/Performance Resus/Majors Trolleys/Majors Ambulant/Minors/Paeds.xlsx).

cuh_extracts.note: Reference blocks below are transcribed from CHEQS batch 1 for validation and manual calibration. They are NOT auto-consumed by the calibration patch (patch_from_aggregates reads only the blocks above); the engine's service times are tuned against the observed 4-hour figure via auto-calibration, with these medians as the sense-check.

stage_time_medians_june_2026_mins.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Performance *.xlsx, June 2026 rows (median minutes).

sdec.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Performance SDEC.xlsx (26,022 attendances / 181 days; 4,179 admitted; breaches 51.01%).

weekly_performance.note: VALIDATION TARGETS, and the first REAL week-to-week spread the build has had: 50 consecutive weeks, 7 Sep 2025 - 16 Aug 2026, so the good/tough week bands on the control tower can be checked against what CUH actually experienced instead of resting on simulated replications alone. COUNTING BASIS: this is CUH's internal CHEQS basis (mean 60.9% in 4 hours), NOT the published Type 1 series (52.93%) - the same ~7-point gap already logged for the Feb-Jul figure of 59.5%. The 12-hour column is the 12-hours-FROM-ARRIVAL measure (mean 10.0% over 12 hours), which is the ECDS basis (11.32%), NOT the DTA basis the model's twelve_hour_pct target uses (3.7%). Compare like with like.
weekly_performance.miu: The co-located MIU runs 99.4% in 4 hours and 100% under 12 hours - it is a separate, uncongested stream and is NOT part of the modelled front door.
weekly_performance.source: CUH CHEQS extracts: data/cuh/4-hour perf.xlsx and data/cuh/12-hour perf.xlsx, rows Site='CUH on-site' (50 weekly points each).

mental_health.note: REAL. 1,067 MH attendances: 195 admitted, 443 discharged with no follow-up, 144 GP follow-up, 130 did-not-wait, 19 refused treatment and left. The did-not-wait rate matters because 'walked out unseen' (LWBS) is a headline control-tower tile with no real anchor anywhere else in the build - MH patients leave before being seen at ~12%, far above any department-wide assumption. NOT auto-consumed: the model has no MH-specific admission or LWBS parameter yet (mh_liaison is a single service node), so this is calibration reference until that seam exists.
mental_health.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/MH Disposals.xlsx (daily disposal counts, 104 days).

trust_discharges_by_weekday.note: REAL and material, but NOT CONSUMED - the engine has no day-of-week dimension at all (arrivals are a 24-hour profile repeated identically every day, and bed releases are a flow rate). Sunday discharges are 29% of Monday's; that weekend collapse in bed releases is a principal driver of Monday exit-block, 12-hour DTA waits and ambulance handover delay, and the model currently cannot reproduce any of it. Wiring a day-of-week dimension into the SD bed model is the single highest-value engine change this batch points to.
trust_discharges_by_weekday.source: CUH CHEQS extract: data/cuh/Discharges by day.xlsx (whole-trust inpatient discharges by day of week, 19,352 total).

investigation_and_procedure_mix.note: REFERENCE, not consumed. Per-week counts by SNOMED-coded investigation and procedure type, 16 weeks (14 complete) May-Aug 2026. Top investigations per week: complete blood count 1,706, CRP 1,418, serum lactate 1,309, venous blood gas 1,268, hepatic panel 1,263, plain radiography 1,235, ECG 903, CT 576. Top procedures per week: drug administration 1,266, written advice 951, IV infusion 851, IV push 670, IV cannulation 605. Only the CT and plain-radiography lines feed the model today (see investigation_rates); the rest is available for a future pathology/turnaround seam, which is where the 'treatment to departure' tail at CUH most likely sits.
investigation_and_procedure_mix.source: CUH CHEQS extracts: data/cuh/Investigation types.xlsx, data/cuh/Procedure type.xlsx.
